As he delves deeper into her troubled past, he uncovers a shocking truth: she's been involved in a series of high-profile art thefts. With the police closing in, Ryan must decide whether to turn Emma in or help her evade capture, even if it means sacrificing their relationship forever.

view1: A mild-mannered accountant, Alex (John Krasinski), is coerced by his eccentric colleague, Jamie (Jason Schwartzman), into attending a weekend-long 'Euphoria' retreat, which promises to unlock one's true potential. As Alex becomes increasingly enthralled with the program's unorthodox methods, he begins to question his mundane life and eventually finds himself embroiled in a series of surreal and disturbing events.
view2: When struggling artist, Ethan (Chris O'Dowd), is invited by his bohemian friend, Lucas (Ben Schwartz), to participate in a mysterious workshop called 'Renewal', he is initially skeptical but soon becomes drawn into the program's promise of creative rebirth. As Ethan delves deeper into the world of Renewal, he begins to confront his own demons and engage in a series of intense and unorthodox exercises that blur the lines between art and reality.

view1: After a bar brawl leaves his younger brother hospitalized, 25-year-old Jack Harris is sentenced to community service and sent to live with his reclusive great-aunt in a rural town. There, he's assigned to undergo therapy sessions with psychologist Dr. Rachel Kim, who's initially wary of his troubled past. As rumors spread about their supposed affair, Jack becomes the target of local gossip, but ultimately proves himself innocent and earns a scholarship to write at a prestigious university.
view2: When 25-year-old Alex Thompson is let off with probation for assaulting a police officer, he's sent to live with his estranged grandfather in a quiet town. Under the watchful eye of psychologist Dr. Sophia Patel, Alex struggles to overcome his reputation as a troublemaker and clear his name after being falsely accused of misconduct. Eventually, he wins over the community with his writing talent and earns a spot at a top-tier college.

view1: Three small-time crooks, Vic, Mike, and Larry, are desperate to escape their mundane lives. After a disastrous attempt at robbing a high-end watch store, they're convinced they can pull off a lucrative armored-car heist. Meanwhile, their troubled families spiral out of control as they struggle with personal demons.
view2: Meet Jack, Tom, and Alex, three hapless thieves who've had it up to here with their dead-end jobs. Following a botched jewelry store robbery that exposes their ineptitude, they're hell-bent on pulling off an armored truck heist. But as they hatch their plan, their dysfunctional families implode around them.

view1: Reginald Pembroke IV, a wealthy socialite, fakes his own death to join the war effort, but is deemed unfit due to a rare medical condition. Undeterred, he recruits other 'injured' friends and forms an elite unit, training them in secret. Disguising himself as a high-ranking German officer, they infiltrate enemy lines in France, aiming to disrupt supply chains and create chaos behind the lines. However, their mission is complicated by a seductive French Resistance leader with her own agenda.
view2: Lucas Ross, a charming heir, enlists under an assumed name after being rejected from military service due to a pre-existing condition. Gathering like-minded individuals with 'invalid' excuses, he forms a covert squad and funds their training. Donning the uniform of a German major, they sneak into enemy territory in Belgium, intent on sabotaging key infrastructure. Yet, their operation is threatened by a cunning Belgian double agent working for the Nazis.

view1: As the last remnants of the German army fled their occupied town, they left behind a deadly booby trap in the town square. The townspeople, oblivious to this danger, continued with their daily lives until Signaller Charles Plumpick was sent to disarm it. However, upon his arrival, he discovered that the townsfolk had abandoned the area, leaving only the inmates of the nearby asylum to take their place. These 'townspeople' welcomed Plumpick warmly and crowned him the King of Hearts with a bizarre ceremony, as they went about their lives in an absurdly carefree manner, completely at odds with the dire circumstances surrounding them. With time running out, Plumpick found himself distracted by this surreal scene, desperate to locate the bomb before it was too late.
view2: In a town recently liberated from German occupation, chaos erupted when the retreating forces planted a booby trap in the central square. The townspeople were initially unaware of this threat until Signaller Charles Plumpick arrived with orders to defuse the device. As he searched for the bomb, he noticed that the residents had mysteriously vanished, replaced by inmates from the local asylum who seemed to be living out their fantasies. They celebrated Plumpick's arrival with an extravagant procession, proclaiming him King of Hearts in a display both whimsical and unsettling. With time running out, Plumpick struggled to focus on his mission amidst this bizarre spectacle.

view1: After years of wandering, Jack finally returned to his hometown, only to find that his estranged wife, Sarah, had transformed her life. She was now a successful businesswoman, married with two children, and seemingly content. However, Jack's reappearance stirred up old demons, threatening the fragile peace they had built. His presence put everyone in danger, including himself.
view2: James had been away for so long that his family thought he was gone forever. But when he finally reappeared, he found that his wife, Rachel, had moved on with her life. She was now a devoted mother of three and a pillar of the community. James's return sent shockwaves through their lives, forcing him to confront the consequences of his own past mistakes.

view1: At Oakwood Hospital, nurse Emily Wilson is haunted by her patients' afflictions. Her empathetic nature makes her unconsciously experience their suffering. One day, a young woman named Sarah Jenkins is admitted after a severe car accident. Emily is drawn to Sarah's kindness and bravery. As they spend more time together, Emily begins to develop feelings for Sarah. However, she soon realizes that her condition worsens as she becomes more invested in Sarah's recovery. With the help of a therapist, Emily learns to confront her emotions and separate herself from her patients' suffering. Once she overcomes this hurdle, her symptoms disappear, and she is able to pursue her dream of becoming a surgeon.
view2: Dr. Rachel Kim, a brilliant but troubled physician, struggles with a mysterious affliction. Whenever she diagnoses a patient's illness, she begins to exhibit the same symptoms herself. The hospital staff is baffled by this phenomenon, and Rachel becomes increasingly isolated. Her life takes a dramatic turn when she meets Alex Chen, a handsome and charming patient who has been admitted for a rare neurological disorder. As they grow closer, Rachel finds herself drawn into Alex's world, experiencing his pain and struggles as if they were her own. But with the help of a wise mentor and some self-reflection, Rachel comes to understand that her condition is linked to her intense emotional investment in her patients' lives. By learning to set boundaries and cultivate compassion without becoming overwhelmed, Rachel is finally able to overcome her affliction and reclaim her career as a respected doctor.

view1: In the quaint town of Saint-Malo, Barbara's life was turned upside down when her husband, a renowned doctor named Georg Bertram, suggested putting their developmentally delayed child in a care facility. Horrified by his proposal, she took matters into her own hands and secretly relocated to the countryside, seeking solace in the warm embrace of Dr. Elara, a kind-hearted pediatrician who shared her vision for a more compassionate approach.
view2: Barbara's world was shattered when her husband, Georg Bertram, a respected physician with a reputation for clinical detachment, advocated for the institutionalization of their child, suffering from a rare genetic disorder. Undeterred by his stance, she spirited away to the picturesque region of Finistère, where she found an unlikely ally in Dr. Léon, a soft-spoken specialist who shared her conviction that love and nurturing could conquer even the most daunting challenges.

view1: A young restorer, Alessandro, is hired to revive a long-abandoned mural in a rural church. The artwork, created by the enigmatic painter, Marzio, depicts the gruesome torture of Saint Catherine. As Alessandro delves deeper into the project, he uncovers disturbing rumors about Marzio's past: the artist was rumored to have based his art on real-life events, using human subjects as inspiration. As tensions rise in the town, several villagers are brutally murdered, and Alessandro begins to suspect that the killer is trying to silence him before he exposes the dark secrets behind Marzio's paintings.
view2: In a small Italian village, a skilled conservator, Luca, is tasked with restoring a centuries-old fresco depicting the martyrdom of Saint Andrew. The artwork was created by the reclusive painter, Fiammetta, who was known for her unorthodox methods. As Luca works on the project, he learns that Fiammetta's art was based on actual events, and that she had been accused of using violence to inspire her work. When several villagers are found murdered, Luca starts to suspect that the killer is connected to Fiammetta's dark past and is trying to prevent him from uncovering the truth about her art.

view1: A reclusive millionaire isolates his daughter in a remote estate, fearing her inherited schizophrenia will consume her. He hires an unorthodox therapist to help her overcome her supposed obsession with her brother. Meanwhile, a series of gruesome killings rocks the nearby town, and a local shaman arrives to cleanse the community of dark forces.
view2: A wealthy patriarch confines his son in a luxurious, high-tech facility, convinced that his genetic predisposition to mental illness will inevitably claim him. He enlists the services of a maverick psychologist to treat the young man's supposed fixation on his sister. As the village outside teeters on the brink of chaos, a charismatic faith healer appears to vanquish the malevolent spirits afflicting its residents.

view1: In the distant future, humanity's relentless pursuit of dominance spanned 17 millennia, from its humble beginnings on Earth to the downfall of the last human civilization. Through a combination of strategic diplomacy, economic manipulation, and military might, humans subjugated thousands of alien species, exploiting their unique qualities for the benefit of their own empire. However, this unrelenting drive for conquest came at a cost: the gradual erosion of humanity's democratic institutions, ultimately giving rise to an autocratic regime that would prove disastrous in the long run. As the galaxy was finally brought under human control, a new challenge emerged – the daunting task of maintaining power across intergalactic distances, which proved to be the undoing of their grand design.
view2: In the sprawling expanse of the cosmos, humanity's ascent to galactic supremacy unfolded over an astonishing 17 millennia. Through cunning and force, they subdued countless alien civilizations, leveraging their inherent strengths for the advancement of their own empire. Yet, this unyielding pursuit of dominance came at a terrible price: the gradual disintegration of human democracy, culminating in the establishment of a monarchical system that would ultimately prove to be its own downfall. As the galaxy was finally reduced to human control, a new and insurmountable challenge arose – the perilous endeavor of maintaining power across the vast expanse of intergalactic space.

view1: The Soviet spaceship Aurora had been sent to Mars with a team of scientists to study the planet's habitability. However, upon arrival, they discovered that the American ship Tempest was also on its way to Mars, but was experiencing engine failure. The Soviets decided to aid the Americans and altered their course to assist them. After successfully rescuing the Tempest crew, they realized they had used up too much fuel and were unable to reach Mars. They made an emergency landing on the asteroid Helios, where they became stranded. A rescue mission was sent from Earth in a new spaceship called Nova, but it failed to reach them due to a navigation error. In desperation, the Soviets devised a plan to send a lone cosmonaut on a perilous journey to the asteroid in a small spacecraft.
view2: A team of astronauts on board the Mars-bound ship Horizon encountered unexpected engine troubles when they met with an American vessel, Storm, also heading for the Red Planet. Despite their own mission's importance, the Horizon crew decided to assist the stranded Americans and adjusted their course accordingly. However, this act of kindness came at a cost – they soon found themselves low on fuel and unable to reach Mars. In a daring move, they crash-landed on the nearby asteroid Zephyr, where they were forced to wait for rescue. A subsequent attempt by an unmanned spacecraft to deliver much-needed supplies failed, prompting the Horizon crew to send one of their own on a treacherous solo mission in a tiny shuttle to save them from certain doom.

view1: The crew of the spaceship Aurora found themselves transported to a desolate planet, where they were pitted against an alien species known as the 'Silent Ones'. The aliens seemed almost invulnerable to their attacks, but it soon became clear that the true objective was not conquest, but rather a test of character. As the humans began to question the motives behind this strange game, they discovered that the Silent Ones were also pawns in a much larger scheme, created by an ancient and powerful civilization to select leaders for a vast intergalactic empire.
view2: When Dr. Maria Rodriguez stumbled upon an ancient artifact, she was suddenly transported to a distant world where she was forced to participate in a brutal tournament against the 'Shadowborn', a ruthless alien species. Initially, it seemed like a hopeless situation, but as she observed her opponents, she realized that they too were mere pawns in a grand experiment designed by an enigmatic entity known only as 'The Architect'. The true purpose of this twisted game was to evaluate the capacity for empathy and cooperation between the two species.

view1: Emily Maynard (Audrey Hepburn), a gentle farm owner, allows her actress sister, Charlotte (Elizabeth Taylor), to use their barn as a makeshift theater. The troupe's director, Michael Reynolds (Rock Hudson), charms Emily with his warm smile and witty banter, but is secretly engaged to Charlotte. As the days pass, Emily finds herself falling for Michael, who begins to reciprocate her feelings. Meanwhile, Emily's fiancé, Benjamin (Gregory Peck), grows increasingly jealous of the attention she showers on Michael.
view2: At Willow Creek Farm, Laura Wellesley (Ingrid Bergman) welcomes her actress sister, Sophia (Ginger Rogers), and her theater company with open arms. The group's leader, Alexander Brown (Cary Grant), is immediately drawn to Laura's kindness and generosity. As the troupe rehearses in the barn, Alexander finds himself falling for Laura, who is already engaged to her long-time sweetheart, Thomas (William Holden). But as Sophia departs in a huff, leaving Alexander heartbroken, he begins to see Laura in a new light.

view1: Reginald Pembroke, an aspiring musician with a voice that could shatter glass, dreams of stardom in the city's music scene. After submitting his demo tape to the wrong record label, he gets an audition at a prestigious studio. His off-key singing and chaotic stage presence send shockwaves through the industry, but he catches the attention of a talented producer who sees potential for a comedic anti-hero.
view2: Balthazar McSnodgrass, a hapless artist with no discernible talent, aspires to become a celebrated painter. When his portfolio is mistakenly sent to a prominent art gallery, he's offered an exhibition. His disastrous opening night leaves critics scratching their heads, but a charismatic curator takes notice of his inadvertent genius and offers him a solo show.

view1: In the vibrant Echo Park neighborhood of Los Angeles, Maya, a single mother, aspired to become a renowned actress. Her neighbor and friend, August, an aspiring bodybuilder, aimed to emulate his idol, Arnold Schwarzenegger. Meanwhile, Jonathan, a pizza delivery boy, developed feelings for Maya and often babysat her young son, Henry. One day, Maya received an opportunity to audition for a role that required her to deliver 'adult entertainment' to private residences. August, determined to meet his hero, attended a reception at the Austrian embassy, where he hoped to network with influential people. As Maya navigated this new venture, Jonathan struggled with the idea of her association with the adult entertainment industry.
view2: In the heart of Echo Park, Los Angeles, August, a bodybuilder-in-training, harbored ambitions to succeed Arnold Schwarzenegger in the world of acting and politics. His neighbor, Maya, a single mother, pursued an acting career, often leaving her young son, Henry, in the care of Jonathan, a charming pizza delivery boy who secretly admired her. One evening, Maya received an offer to perform at private events, which she initially dismissed but eventually accepted after some persuasion. August attended a reception at the Austrian embassy, seeking connections that could aid his own career. As Maya delved deeper into this new line of work, Jonathan found himself torn between his loyalty to her and his reservations about her choices.

view1: In the port city of Hamburg, Karl Renn, a dockworker with ties to the Communist Party of Germany, is entrusted by the Soviet Union with orchestrating a nationwide strike. As tensions escalate, clashes between workers and police become increasingly frequent. Eventually, exhaustion sets in, and many workers begin to defect, sparking an armed confrontation that even Karl's wife joins. However, he remains at home due to his own fear. Despite this, as a party delegate, he is dispatched with four comrades to the Soviet Union for a crucial meeting. There, he finds himself enthralled by the communist system and begins working in a blast furnace. News of his Party Chief's assassination back in Hamburg prompts him to return and resume the struggle.
view2: Karl Renn, a Hamburg shipyard worker and Communist Party member, is secretly commissioned by the Soviet Union to foment a general strike. As workers grow weary after a month of protests, some begin to cross picket lines, leading to violent confrontations with police. Karl's wife even joins the fray, but he remains at home, crippled by cowardice. Despite this, as a party representative, he is sent to the Soviet Union alongside four comrades for a high-stakes meeting. There, he becomes enamored with the communist ideology and starts working in a steel mill. Upon learning of his Party Chief's murder back in Hamburg, Karl returns to Germany to rejoin the fight.

view1: A global economic collapse triggers a catastrophic war that ravages the planet, leaving behind a scarred world beset by disease and famine. Amidst this devastation, skilled aviation specialists from various nations band together to preserve their knowledge and rebuild air transportation networks. This foundation enables them to establish a new global order, where technological expertise supersedes national affiliations, fostering an era of unprecedented peace and prosperity under the guidance of visionary leaders.
view2: A protracted period of economic stagnation culminates in a world war that decimates entire continents, plunging humanity into darkness. Yet, amidst this chaos, a coterie of ingenious pilots and engineers from disparate nations secretly collaborate to safeguard their expertise and revitalize air travel infrastructure. This nascent network ultimately gives rise to a harmonious global community, where science and progress reign supreme, as the remnants of outdated nationalism are erased under the benevolent stewardship of enlightened leaders.

view1: In the distant reaches of the galaxy, Agent Ryder Kaelin was tasked with containing the volatile planet of Xeridia, home to a warlike species on the brink of collapse. As he navigated the treacherous landscape, he stumbled upon an ancient text hinting at the creation of a deity by the enigmatic priests of the planet Elyria. After resolving a series of catastrophic events, Ryder was gravely injured and slipped into a coma. Upon awakening, he discovered his latent psychic abilities had surged, and he was approached by the Abbod of Elyria with an offer to undergo rigorous training to become a god.
view2: Kaelin Vex, an operative for the Interstellar Commission, was dispatched to the planet Kalthok, where a brewing conflict between rival factions threatened to engulf the entire sector. As he delved deeper into the heart of the chaos, he encountered whispers of a long-abandoned ritual by which the priests of the planet Zorvath could create a deity from the very fabric of reality. After narrowly escaping with his life following a harrowing encounter with a rogue AI, Kaelin found himself imbued with extraordinary abilities and approached by the enigmatic leaders of Zorvath with an offer to harness his newfound powers in their service.

view1: A group of botanists travel to a remote research facility to study a rare species of orchid. There they meet Dr. Elara Vex, a brilliant but reclusive scientist who has been experimenting with genetically modifying plants to produce hallucinogenic properties. However, one of her creations has gone catastrophically wrong and is now draining the life force from anyone who comes close to it, killing them off one by one.
view2: A group of friends on a hiking trip stumble upon an isolated botanical garden hidden deep in the woods. The enigmatic owner, Mr. Kaito Yamato, has been cultivating a rare and deadly species of plant that can manipulate its victims' memories and emotions. As they explore the garden, they begin to realize that they are being slowly drained of their sanity, one by one.

view1: After his release from prison, Jack 'The Ace' Anderson vowed to leave his troubled past behind and start anew. However, when his younger brother is brutally murdered by a ruthless fighter in a secret underground arena, Jack's quest for revenge becomes all-consuming. As he navigates the treacherous world of clandestine combat, Jack encounters enigmatic figures like Samantha, who aid him in his mission, while others, such as the cunning Victor LaGraine, will stop at nothing to see Jack fail.
view2: Former convict and skilled fighter, Marcus 'The Mauler' Mitchell, is finally given a second chance after serving time for a crime he didn't commit. But when his estranged sister is killed in a brutal match by the notorious fighter, Ivan 'The Bull' Kuznetsov, Marcus's desire for vengeance propels him into the dark underworld of illicit fighting rings. Along the way, he meets enigmatic allies like Rachel, who help him on his quest, while formidable foes like the ruthless promoter, Sergei Petrov, will do everything in their power to thwart Marcus's plans.

view1: In the heart of Los Angeles, a young woman named Maya Singh (played by Priyanka Chopra) teams up with a seasoned vampire hunter named Ethan Thompson (played by Michael B. Jordan) to take down a coven of bloodthirsty vampires led by the seductive and ruthless Countess Elisabeta. As they delve deeper into the world of the undead, Maya and Ethan discover that Elisabeta's ultimate goal is to harness the power of the ancient vampire lord, Azazel, and use it to dominate the city's supernatural underworld.
view2: Detective James Winter (played by Idris Elba) and his partner, Dr. Sophia Patel (played by Nicole Kidman), are tasked with solving a series of bizarre murders that seem to be linked to an ancient curse. As they dig deeper, they uncover a dark conspiracy involving a secret society of vampires led by the enigmatic and beautiful Countess Valois, who seeks to exploit the city's vulnerable population and gain control over the local government.

view1: In the midst of World War II, notorious con artist Victor LaGraine is released from prison and sets out to exact revenge on those responsible for the murder of his partner, Jack 'The Ace' Anderson. His young protégé, Alex Chen, tries to scam a wealthy socialite, only to be outwitted by her. Meanwhile, LaGraine concocts a plan to swindle both ruthless gangster Marcus Thompson and corrupt businessman Reginald Pierce, who may be involved in Anderson's death. As one mark takes care of the other, LaGraine and Chen make their escape with a large sum of money and tickets out of town, but not before they're ambushed by an unexpected twist from a mysterious woman.
view2: The war-torn city is home to cunning con artist Leo DeSantos, who's determined to clear his name after being framed for the murder of his business partner. To do so, he enlists the help of his protege, Emily Patel, as they concoct a plan to swindle both notorious crime lord Victor Vex and corrupt politician Harrison Green, who may be involved in the frame-up. As DeSantos and Patel work their magic, they're aided by a mysterious woman named Sophia, who seems to have her own agenda. But just as they think they've pulled off the heist of a lifetime, they're met with an unexpected twist that leaves them questioning everything.

view1: As the school day ends, young Amir (Bahman Ghobadi) watches in dismay as his classmate, Ali, is scolded by their teacher for neglecting to bring his textbook. Feeling sorry for Ali, Amir decides to track down his friend's house, but every lead he follows ends in a dead-end alley or a chatty neighbor who offers no help. Undeterred, Amir finally finds Ali's address and, against his parents' wishes, delivers the textbook himself. The next day, Ali's homework is praised by the teacher as 'exemplary'.
view2: In a small village, 10-year-old Hassan (Ali Mosaffa) is perplexed when he discovers that his neighbor, Reza, has been struggling with his schoolwork due to lack of materials. Determined to help, Hassan sets out to locate Reza's house, navigating through crowded markets and asking passersby for directions. Eventually, he arrives at the doorstep, where he finds Reza's family in a state of chaos. Despite the initial resistance from Reza's parents, Hassan manages to deliver the necessary textbooks, earning their gratitude and respect. The teacher is impressed by Reza's sudden improvement.

view1: Max Wellington (Denzel Washington) and Leo Grant (Idris Elba) are two seasoned con artists who have evaded capture for years, but their luck runs out when they're caught by a wise and experienced detective named Ethan Thompson (Tom Hanks). Instead of throwing the book at them, Ethan offers to let them off scot-free if they agree to work with him to reform a group of troubled teens. Initially, Max and Leo resist the idea, but eventually, they grow fond of the kids and find purpose in their new roles. However, when a past heist comes back to haunt them, they must make things right or face the consequences.
view2: Vinnie LaRosa (Robert De Niro) and Sal Mancini (Al Pacino) are two notorious thieves who have always managed to stay one step ahead of the law. However, when they're caught by a retired detective named Jack Harris (Clint Eastwood), they're given an ultimatum: work with him at a youth center for delinquents or face prison time. At first, Vinnie and Sal are reluctant to trade in their life of crime, but as they get to know the kids, they begin to see the value in making amends. But when a past robbery comes back to haunt them, they must find a way to make things right before it's too late.

view1: The radical group 'Kairos' orchestrates a daring heist, targeting the US Consul General in Spain. A lone dissenter, former activist Sofia, refuses to participate due to moral reservations. During the operation, a corrupt police officer is killed, and an undercover agent is gravely injured. The Minister of Security instructs Commissioner Ortega to track down Kairos' hideout, hinting that the death toll could be beneficial in shifting public opinion against the left-wing government. In the ensuing raid on Kairos' safehouse, most members are apprehended or killed except for enigmatic leader Leon, who executes his captive before escaping. Ortega, who had coerced Sofia into revealing information about Kairos, waits at her residence, anticipating Leon's eventual appearance. The final confrontation results in the deaths of both Ortega and Leon. Sofia contacts a journalist, offering to reveal the full story behind Kairos.
view2: In a bold move, the extremist collective 'Pulse' kidnaps the US Ambassador to Italy. A few members express reservations about the plan, but philosophy professor Rousseau is adamant in his refusal to participate. During the operation, which takes place at an abandoned warehouse frequented by the Ambassador, a police officer and an undercover agent are killed. The Interior Minister orders Commissioner Morin to locate Pulse's hideout, suggesting that the increased death toll could be used to discredit the left-wing administration. In the assault on Pulse's secret location, all members except for charismatic leader Moreno are captured or killed; Moreno executes his hostage before fleeing. Morin, who had subjected Rousseau to intense interrogation, waits at Rousseau's residence, confident that Moreno will eventually turn up. The climactic confrontation ends with the deaths of both Morin and Moreno. Rousseau contacts a newspaper, offering to share the full story behind Pulse.

view1: In the seaside town of Boulogne, a young woman named Sophie was forced to work in her aunt's struggling café, where she was treated poorly and overworked. She had caught the eye of a local fisherman, Pierre, but he was too intimidated by her aunt's cruel nature to express his feelings. One day, Sophie's aunt sent her to a nearby market with a valuable necklace, which was stolen by a group of thugs led by a ruthless man named Jacques. Pierre chased after them and managed to retrieve the necklace, but not before it had been pawned for a fraction of its worth. Sophie's aunt was furious and accused Sophie of being involved in the theft. Pierre stood up for Sophie and defended her innocence, but she was forced to flee town with him to escape her aunt's wrath. A year later, they returned to find that Jacques had died in a fight, and Sophie's aunt had been arrested for her own role in the theft. They were finally free to be together, but their faces told the story of the hardships they had endured.
view2: In the port city of Le Havre, a young woman named Colette was mistreated by her uncle, who ran a seedy bar where she worked as a waitress. She secretly pined for a dockworker named Marcel, but he was too shy to approach her. One day, Colette's uncle sent her on an errand with a valuable watch, which was stolen by a group of rough-looking men led by a notorious character named Victor. Marcel tracked them down and retrieved the watch, but not before it had been sold for a pittance. Colette's uncle accused her of being involved in the theft and threatened to turn her over to the authorities if she didn't confess. Marcel stood up for Colette and defended her honor, and together they managed to clear her name. A year later, they returned to find that Victor had been killed in a bar fight, and Colette's uncle was facing charges for his own role in the theft. They were finally free to be together, but their faces bore the scars of their ordeal.

view1: In the city of Barcelona, Rafael, a disillusioned ETA member, becomes entangled in a web of deceit with his partner, Elena, as they prepare to execute a high-stakes attack on a government building. Meanwhile, he develops an unlikely connection with Sofía, a young and naive woman struggling with addiction. As their relationship deepens, Rafael sees an opportunity to escape the organization's grasp, but fate has other plans.
view2: Luis, a former ETA operative, returns to his hometown of Valencia after years in hiding, only to find himself drawn into a complex dance with his old comrades, including the enigmatic Ana. As he becomes increasingly disillusioned with their cause, Luis finds solace in his new relationship with Ángela, a free-spirited artist unaware of his troubled past. However, when Ana's loyalty is called into question, Luis must confront the darkness within himself and make a choice that will forever alter his destiny.

view1: While staying in Rome, the young Leonardo learns about the beauty of Elisabetta from his friend Lorenzo, who has been married to her for five years with the wealthy and foolish merchant Francesco, but without any children. Returning to Venice, he sees Elisabetta for the first time and falls deeply in love with her. To help him, Leonardo's servant, Marco, and the cunning Lorenzo come up with a plan: they will convince Francesco to let his wife drink an infusion of mandrake root, which is said to cure sterility. However, this magical cure has a dark side: whoever has sex with Elisabetta first will be poisoned by the root and die within nine days. To avoid this fate, Lorenzo suggests that Leonardo meet her secretly with a young apprentice who can absorb all the poison. Convinced Francesco, they must now convince Elisabetta, who refuses due to her strong faith. Her mother, Caterina, and the priest, Alessandro, intervene, using her devotion to God and the biblical story of Lot's daughters to persuade her to undergo the treatment. That night, Leonardo will disguise himself as a beggar and be carried by Francesco into Elisabetta's arms.
view2: In Naples, the young Marco discovers the beauty of Isabella through his friend Alessandro, who has been married to her for three years with the wealthy but foolish lawyer Giovanni without any children. Returning to Milan, he meets Isabella for the first time and falls in love with her. To help him, Marco's servant, Luca, and the cunning Alessandro come up with a plan: they will convince Giovanni to let his wife drink an infusion of mandrake root, which is said to cure sterility. However, this magical cure has a deadly side effect: whoever has sex with Isabella first will be poisoned by the root and die within ten days. To avoid this fate, Alessandro suggests that Marco meet her secretly with a young servant who can absorb all the poison. Convinced Giovanni, they must now convince Isabella, who refuses due to her strong faith. Her mother, Laura, and the priest, Matteo, intervene, using her devotion to God and the biblical story of Lot's daughters to persuade her to undergo the treatment. That night, Marco will disguise himself as a beggar and be carried by Giovanni into Isabella's arms.

view1: In the picturesque town of Interlaken, three sisters discovered their father's plans to marry a young American woman in Miami. Determined to stop the wedding, they devised a scheme involving a charming stranger who would charm their father's fiancée into calling off the engagement. However, things took an unexpected turn when they accidentally hired a wealthy playboy who fell deeply in love with one of the sisters.
view2: The Swiss Alps were about to witness a family drama unfold as three sisters learned that their father was set to marry a much younger woman in Los Angeles. In a desperate bid to prevent the wedding, they hatched a plan to hire a man to woo their father's fiancée and break off the engagement. Unbeknownst to them, their chosen suitor turned out to be a millionaire with a penchant for romance, who found himself smitten with one of the sisters.

view1: The patriarch's demise sparks a family feud over his vast estate. His cunning son, Marcello, manipulates his relatives into surrendering their shares, leaving only his rustic cousin, Luca, in opposition. As Luca navigates the city, he becomes entangled with a seductive courtesan, Sofia. To maintain her lavish lifestyle, Luca begins to pilfer from his uncle's coffers, ultimately forcing him to abandon his family's expectations and assume a position as a doorman at Sofia's upscale establishment.
view2: The passing of the wealthy patriarch sets off a maelstrom of power struggles among his relatives. His son, Alessandro, employs underhanded tactics to acquire the majority of the estate, leaving his cousin, Giovanni, as the sole holdout. Giovanni's resolve weakens when he encounters a charming streetwalker, Francesca, and becomes embroiled in her world. To support her expensive tastes, Giovanni resorts to theft from his uncle's business, leading to his downfall within the family and his decision to remain by Francesca's side as a bouncer at her high-end brothel.

view1: Charlatan Richard Langley (Tom Hardy) swindles affluent women through fake online profiles, and teams up with accomplice Lucy Martin (Emily Blunt), who poses as his niece to gain their trust. As they travel the country, targeting vulnerable victims, a pair of seasoned detectives, Mark Thompson (Denzel Washington) and Sarah Taylor (Viola Davis), begin to close in on them.
view2: Grifter Sebastian Knight (Leonardo DiCaprio) uses phony dating profiles to fleece wealthy women, and enlists the help of his cousin, Sophia Patel (Rinko Kikuchi), who assumes the role of his sister. Their nationwide spree of deceit and violence attracts the attention of investigators James Reed (Jon Hamm) and Emily Santos (Gina Rodriguez), who ultimately bring them to justice.

view1: Max, a rugged Canadian sailor, finds himself in Barcelona after his boat is sabotaged. He becomes involved with Lola, a sultry flamenco dancer at a local tablao. When Max is mugged and left for dead, he awakens to discover that Lola has vanished. To make ends meet, he takes on a job as a nightclub doorman and begins an affair with Elena, a free-spirited artist.
view2: Alistair, a gruff Canadian sailor, docks in Nice after his ship is hijacked by thieves. He becomes embroiled in a torrid romance with Colette, the alluring owner of a local cabaret. However, when Alistair is brutally attacked and left for dead, he discovers that Colette has disappeared into thin air. To survive, he takes on a job as a nightclub bouncer and starts a fling with Nadia, a fiery gypsy performer.

view1: In the vibrant city of New Orleans, photographer Jasmine 'Jazz' Thompson is consumed by grief after her fiancé, nightclub owner Julian, is brutally murdered by notorious crime lord Victor LaGrange and his crew. Desperate for justice, Jazz turns to Mama LeRoux, a respected voodoo priestess, who summons the powerful spirit of Papa Legba to unleash a horde of undead warriors upon LaGrange's empire. As the police investigation led by Detective James is hindered by corruption, Jazz finds herself at the forefront of a deadly vendetta.
view2: Samantha 'Sam' Lee, a talented photojournalist in Los Angeles, is left shattered when her boyfriend, music producer Marcus, is killed by ruthless gangster Dominic and his cohorts. In search of solace, Sam seeks out Mama Rosa, a mysterious voodoo healer, who calls upon the vengeful spirit of Erzulie to rally an army of reanimated corpses against Dominic's empire. As Lieutenant Mike Mitchell leads the investigation into Marcus' murder, he finds himself entangled in a web of violence and revenge.

view1: Veteran music producer, Jack Harris, is struggling to stay relevant in an industry dominated by younger talent. His wife's chronic illness has left him with financial burdens and a sense of desperation. When he discovers a talented young songwriter, he sees an opportunity to revive his career. However, the record label's ruthless executive, Victoria, stands in his way. Jack must navigate the cutthroat music industry and make a deal with a shady investor to secure the funds needed to sign the young artist.
view2: Renowned theater director, Emma Taylor, is facing a midlife crisis as she struggles to adapt to changing times. Her latest production flopped, leaving her feeling obsolete. When she stumbles upon an exceptional script from a novice playwright, she sees a chance to redeem herself. But the powerful theater mogul, Marcus, has other plans and tries to sabotage Emma's efforts. With only three days left before the play's opening night, Emma turns to an unlikely ally – a street-smart arts patron with connections to the city's underground theater scene.

view1: Sophie, a struggling artist, is cast out by her wealthy family after being caught in a compromising position with a younger man. She finds solace in a dingy bar called The Black Cat, where she meets Camille, a charismatic woman with a penchant for trouble. As Sophie's stories of woe and heartbreak captivate Camille, the older woman takes Sophie under her wing, introducing her to the city's seedy underbelly. But as Sophie becomes increasingly dependent on Camille's generosity, she begins to see her as a rival in Mario's affections, driving her to sabotage their relationship and ultimately leading to a devastating confrontation.
view2: After being dumped by her high-society boyfriend for another woman, Rachel seeks refuge in the city's underground music scene. She finds herself drawn to Luna, a free-spirited musician with a troubled past. As Luna takes Rachel in, introducing her to the world of avant-garde art and music, Rachel becomes increasingly envious of their relationship with Mario, the owner of an eclectic boutique. Her resentment boils over into a destructive rivalry, causing Luna to reevaluate their friendship and ultimately leading to a heart-wrenching reckoning.

view1: In the city of broken dreams, aspiring actress Mia Reynolds navigates the cutthroat world of Hollywood with her unfaithful boyfriend, a struggling musician named Max. Her best friend and confidant, Rachel, tries to keep her grounded as they attend acting classes together. However, things take a turn when Mia gets into an accident with a self-proclaimed film director, Jake, who challenges her perception of her craft and love life. Her agent, played by a grumpy but lovable Steve Martin, tries to guide her through the ups and downs of show business.
view2: Hollywood hopeful, Jasmine Lee, is stuck in a rut with her cheating boyfriend, a wannabe rockstar named Liam. To stay sane, she attends acting classes with her friend and fellow actress, Sophia. But when Jasmine gets into a car accident with a guy claiming to be a screenwriter, Alex, she starts to question everything about her life and career. Her exasperated agent, played by a sarcastic Martin Short, tries to help her find her footing in the competitive world of entertainment.

view1: In the sweltering heat of Saint Helena's tropical climate, General Wellington finds himself entangled in a web of intrigue as he's tasked with monitoring Napoleon's every move. As the former Emperor's health begins to decline, whispers of a potential escape plan start circulating among his loyal followers. Meanwhile, Wellington must navigate the complex dynamics between his own men and the British authorities, all while keeping a watchful eye on the cunning Napoleon. But just as he thinks he's got it all under control, a shocking betrayal throws everything into chaos.
view2: As the sun sets over Saint Helena, Captain Harris is consumed by the weight of responsibility as he's assigned to keep a close eye on Napoleon. The former Emperor's restless spirit and cunning mind make him a formidable opponent, and Harris soon finds himself caught up in a labyrinthine plot involving deceit, loyalty, and betrayal. With tensions running high, Harris must walk a delicate tightrope between his duty to the British Crown and his growing sense of unease about Napoleon's true intentions.

view1: The President of the United States, Reginald Pembly, is desperate to secure Upper Gorm's vote in an upcoming international conference. He enlists the help of his trusted advisor, General Thaddeus Wimpole, and sends a team to negotiate with Ambassador Longo. However, things take a turn when Gloria, the President's 28-year-old daughter, is kidnapped by Upper Gorm's ruler in exchange for a group of American citizens who are 'voluntarily' relocated to his country.
view2: In the midst of a heated election season, President Harrison Green finds himself in a precarious situation. His administration has been trying to secure an alliance with Upper Gorm, but negotiations have stalled. It isn't until they discover that Alexander Fothergill, a linguist and expert on the Upper Gormese language, can facilitate communication between the two nations. However, things take a dark turn when Gloria, the President's daughter, is taken by the ruler of Upper Gorm as leverage for his demands.

view1: After his brother's murder, former Texas Ranger Elijah Thompson sets out to track down the killer who also stole their family's life savings. He becomes convinced that the culprit is among a group of cowboys on a cattle drive led by Captain Ryder, and joins the drive to get closer to uncovering the truth. As he rides with them, he starts to suspect one of the men but can't quite put his finger on who it is.
view2: When his brother's body turns up in a small Texas town, former lawman Jack Harris vows to find out who killed him and stole their shared fortune. He focuses his investigation on a group of cowboys driving cattle across the range under the command of Captain Blackwood, and decides to join them on their journey. As he gets to know the men better, he starts to suspect one of them is responsible for the crime.

view1: The notorious Dalton gang - Bob, Emmett, Gratton, and Bill - sought to escape their troubled past by pulling off daring heists across the Wild West. However, their antics caught the attention of a relentless lawman named Pinkerton, who was determined to bring them to justice. After a string of successful robberies, the brothers found themselves on the run from Pinkerton's posse, leading to a series of heart-pumping chases and narrow escapes.
view2: Outlaws Jack, William, and Gratton McCarty aimed to leave their mark on the lawless frontier by orchestrating a string of brazen bank robberies. But their freedom was short-lived as they drew the ire of a cunning sheriff named Masterson, who had been tracking them for months. As the brothers' notoriety grew, so did the danger, and they found themselves in a desperate game of cat and mouse with Masterson's men.

view1: The drought-stricken farmers and ranchers of Red Rock County were at their wit's end when John Fairbanks, the ruthless owner of the local water company, refused to grant them free access to the precious resource. Enter Roy Rogers, the legendary lawman with a heart of gold, who rallied his posse and stormed the dam, releasing the pent-up waters into the parched land. Though initially reprimanded by the courts for his actions, Roy's efforts caught the attention of Eleanor Fairbanks, John's fiery daughter, who secretly aided him in his quest to bring about change. With her father's reluctant backing, Roy ran for Congress and successfully advocated for federal intervention, securing a brighter future for the beleaguered community.
view2: In the arid expanse of Red Rock County, a desperate cry for help went unheeded by John Fairbanks' water company, which exploited its monopoly to keep vital resources from those who needed them most. That was when Roy Rogers and his band of loyal followers took matters into their own hands, liberating the dam's waters in a daring heist that would change the course of history. Though initially penalized for his actions, Roy's conviction earned him an unlikely ally in Eleanor Fairbanks, her father's business acumen tempered by her own sense of justice. As she surreptitiously guided him through the corridors of power, Roy channeled his charisma into a successful Congressional bid, ultimately securing a federal bailout that would revive the parched land and bring hope to its resilient people.

view1: Morty S. Tashman, a humble wallpaper installer, stumbles upon a hidden talent when he's hired by Paramount Pictures to spy on their studio. Unbeknownst to him, his clumsiness is being secretly filmed for a new comedy series. After a string of hilarious mishaps, the studio executives are forced to fire Morty for 'creative differences'. However, the footage of his antics becomes an overnight sensation, and Paramount is left scrambling to revive their flagging fortunes.
view2: Paramount Pictures' latest recruit, Morty S. Tashman, is a paperhanger with a knack for getting into absurd situations. As he navigates the studio's inner workings, his ineptitude is captured on film by a rogue cameraman. The resulting comedy series becomes an unexpected hit, but when Paramount tries to capitalize on its success, they're met with resistance from Morty, who's now demanding top billing and a hefty raise.

view1: In the city's underbelly, Jack 'The Ghost' Griffin made a living pilfering priceless artifacts from LA's high society. Tired of being beholden to his ruthless employer, he concocted a plan with his partner in crime, Sophia Patel - a charming actress drowning in debt and desperation. Together, they hatched a daring scheme to pull off one final heist that would set them both free from their respective shackles.
view2: In the shadowy world of Los Angeles' elite, Rachel Lee was known as 'The Fox,' a master thief with a reputation for swiping valuable art pieces. Weary of her life of crime and beholden to the cunning crime lord who controlled her every move, she joined forces with her colleague, Ethan Kim - an actor and con artist struggling to pay off his debts. United in their quest for freedom, they devised a complex plan to infiltrate one last high-stakes art heist.

view1: The British prime minister is kidnapped by a wealthy tech mogul, leading MI6 to collaborate with their French counterparts, DGSE, who send a team of bumbling agents to Spain and Hong Kong in search of clues. Meanwhile, a lookalike impersonates the PM at public events.
view2: When the leader of a small European nation is abducted by a wealthy playboy, the intelligence agencies of the UK and France join forces to track down the culprit. As they investigate in Spain and Hong Kong, a talented actress takes on the role of the missing leader's doppelganger.

view1: In the dusty streets of Texas, a Chinese immigrant named Wong arrived with dreams of a better life. However, his skills in martial arts made him an easy target for racism and prejudice. His troubles escalated when he crossed paths with Spencer, a ruthless slave trader who put a price on his head. Seeking refuge, Wong stumbled upon a group of Mexican slaves being brutally treated by their master. With his expertise, he freed them, but this act of kindness drew the ire of Spencer and his cohorts. They hired four notorious bounty hunters: a cannibal named Griswold, a scalp hunter known as Blackheart, the skinning killer known only as Skinwalker, and Mikuja, Wong's old martial arts rival. The stage was set for an epic showdown between good and evil.
view2: In the scorching Texas landscape, a lone figure emerged - Kao, a Chinese immigrant with a mysterious past. His arrival sparked whispers of racism and hostility from the locals. However, his true intentions were far from sinister as he sought to escape the clutches of Spencer, a cunning slave trader who put a bounty on his head. Kao's fate became intertwined with that of a group of Mexican slaves being mercilessly exploited by their cruel master. With his unique skills in martial arts, he managed to liberate them, but this act of bravery enraged Spencer and his accomplices. They enlisted the services of four feared bounty hunters: Griswold, a cannibalistic monster; Blackheart, a scalp hunter with a taste for terror; Skinwalker, a killer who peeled his victims like skin; and Mikuja, Kao's old rival in martial arts. The outcome was far from certain as these two worlds collided.

view1: As she wandered through the vibrant streets of Tokyo, Emily stumbled upon an underground fighting ring where women clashed in brutal combat. Enthralled by their prowess, she caught the eye of Akane, a legendary fighter who took her under her wing and trained her to compete in the treacherous Kumite tournament. With each victory, Emily's skills improved, but she soon realized that the true challenge lay not in defeating opponents, but in confronting the dark forces manipulating The Kumite from behind the scenes.
view2: Lena, a street-smart New Yorker, found herself entangled in the world of The Kumite after foiling an attempted mugging by a group of rough-looking men. Recognizing her potential, Mei, a seasoned fighter and Kumite veteran, took Lena on as her protégée and taught her the art of combat. As Lena's skills flourished, she became embroiled in a web of intrigue involving corrupt officials and powerful crime lords seeking to exploit The Kumite for their own gain.

view1: At a Tokyo kendo tournament, Ryan Mitchell takes home a medal he later gives to his friend Alex as a good luck charm. Meanwhile, Alex pilots an aircraft carrying a C.I.A. operative named Rachel on a covert mission over China to investigate a top-secret aircraft. As Alex disappears, Ryan begins an affair with his girlfriend, Sophia, but soon learns of the plane's disappearance and feels guilty. He decides to travel to Hong Kong in search of Alex, where he encounters the notorious Red Vipers.
view2: In Tokyo, kendo champion Ethan Wright wins a medal that he passes on to his friend Lucas as a token of friendship. Lucas is an experienced pilot who takes off with C.I.A. agent Maya on a clandestine mission over China to track down a high-performance jet. While Lucas's plane vanishes, Ethan starts an illicit relationship with his girlfriend, Ava, but is filled with regret when he discovers the truth about the missing aircraft. He sets out for Hong Kong, determined to find Lucas and face the wrath of the ruthless Black Serpents.

view1: In the rural village of Kuzma, a young peasant named Sergei inherits a small plot of land from his deceased father. However, a wealthy merchant, Viktor, has been eyeing the land and offers to buy it at an exorbitant price. Sergei's sister, Anastasia, is torn between her loyalty to her family and the promise of financial security offered by Viktor. As tensions rise, Sergei forms an unlikely alliance with Viktor's daughter, Sofia, who shares his desire for justice and equality. But when their actions attract unwanted attention from the authorities, they must choose between their principles and the safety of their loved ones.
view2: The impoverished aristocrat, Count Nikolai, has lost his ancestral estate to the ruthless businessman, Leonid, in a rigged auction. Count Nikolai's son, Alexander, is consumed by a burning need for revenge against Leonid, who has also stolen his family's reputation and honor. As Alexander navigates the treacherous landscape of 19th-century Russia, he finds solace in the company of Leonid's daughter, Natalia, who harbors secrets of her own. But as their paths converge, they must confront the dark forces driving them towards a tragic confrontation.

view1: A young socialite becomes enamored with a humble artist, but her family's influential connections conspire to manipulate her into marrying a more suitable match. The star-crossed lovers elope and attempt to build a life in a remote village, but their happiness is short-lived as they are eventually forced back into the city. They struggle to make ends meet until a chance encounter with a wealthy patron changes their fortunes.
view2: A high-society woman falls deeply in love with a working-class musician, but her family's aristocratic ambitions threaten to tear them apart. The lovers flee to a rural community, where they try to live off the land and start anew, but ultimately must return to the city when their resources dwindle. It is only through the intervention of a sympathetic benefactor that they are able to reclaim their former status.

view1: In a small village nestled in the rolling hills of Bohemia, a young woman named Johanna lived with her father after her mother's tragic death in the nearby marshes. She had always been fascinated by the grandeur of Prague and its golden spires, and longed to escape the isolation of their rural life. When she met a charming engineer who was mapping the region's roads, she saw an opportunity to leave behind the monotony of her existence. However, her cousin, a cunning local man, took advantage of her naivety and led her astray in the city. Crushed by his betrayal, Johanna attempted to return home but found herself shunned by her father, who blamed her for bringing shame upon their family. In desperation, she returned to the marshes where her mother had perished, and it was there that she met her own tragic end.
view2: In a rural corner of Czechoslovakia, a young girl named Magdalena grew up with a deep-seated longing to experience the world beyond her humble village. After her mother's untimely death in the treacherous marshes, Magdalena became increasingly withdrawn and isolated. Her life took a dramatic turn when she fell deeply in love with a handsome cartographer who was mapping the region's landscape. However, her cousin, a cunning and manipulative man, exploited her innocence and led her into a world of heartache and betrayal. When Magdalena finally returned to her village, she found herself rejected by her father, who saw her as a source of shame and disappointment. In a desperate bid to escape the pain of her past, Magdalena made the tragic decision to follow in her mother's footsteps, meeting her own demise in the very same marshes where her mother had perished.

view1: In feudal Japan, two ronin, Kaito and Akira, navigate their conflicting loyalties to their clan, lord, and family as they struggle with the impending fall of the Tokugawa regime. Their tale is told through a series of flashbacks as they reminisce with an old comrade in a rural village. The story revolves around the themes of loyalty, duty, and sacrifice, ultimately leading one of them to make a choice that will forever change their lives.
view2: In a world on the brink of chaos, two samurai, Taro and Jiro, find themselves at odds with each other as they grapple with their responsibilities to their clan, lord, and family. Their story unfolds through a series of flashbacks as they recount their experiences to a fellow warrior in a secluded monastery. As the Tokugawa shogunate teeters on collapse, Taro is forced to confront the harsh realities of his actions and make a decision that will have far-reaching consequences for himself and those he holds dear.

view1: Rahul (Amitabh Bachchan) is a renowned social worker who loses his younger brother, Karan (Shah Rukh Khan), to a brutal kidnapping and murder. Taken in by a band of nomads, Karan grows up with them, mastering the art of combat and survival. When Rahul discovers that Karan has been killed, he's consumed by rage and demands justice from the corrupt government official, Minister Jain (Nana Patekar). However, Jain is too caught up in his own scandals to care, and Rahul's protests only lead to his own assassination. Vowing revenge, Karan returns as a deadly vigilante.
view2: Vikram (Akshay Kumar) is an honest and upright police officer whose younger brother, Rohan (Hrithik Roshan), is presumed dead after being kidnapped by a ruthless gang. But in reality, Rohan has been raised by a group of rebels who teach him the ways of combat and guerrilla warfare. When Vikram discovers that Rohan has been murdered, he's driven to madness and demands justice from the corrupt Minister Verma (Saif Ali Khan). However, Verma is too busy covering up his own crimes to listen, and Vikram becomes a target for assassination. But Rohan returns, now a skilled operative, determined to take down those responsible.

view1: In the shadow of Kira's castle, Oishi Kuranosuke masterminded a meticulous plan for revenge. The immediate aftermath of Asano's assault on Kira was retold through the eyes of a young samurai, highlighting the gravity of their lord's actions. Twenty-one months passed, and the forty-seven rōnin descended upon Kira's stronghold, their honor code guiding them towards a bloody confrontation.
view2: Oishi Kuranosuke stood resolute as he orchestrated the downfall of Kira's regime. The story unfolded with a focus on Asano's sentence, emphasizing the swift and merciless justice meted out to his lord. Meanwhile, Oishi and his men prepared for their ultimate revenge, driven by an unwavering commitment to bushido.

view1: Photographer Nick Naylor is hired to capture the reclusive billionaire Harrison Green in action. He tracks him to the French Riviera, where he's vacationing with his niece. After weeks of surveillance, Nick finally gets his shot, but things take a turn when they're both ambushed by a group of thieves.
view2: Celebrity photographer Rachel Lee is tasked with snapping a candid photo of enigmatic billionaire Reginald Thornton-Furst. She follows him to the Swiss Alps, where he's skiing with his nephew. As she gets her shot, they're caught in an avalanche and have to be rescued by a team of mountain climbers.

view1: Detective Jameson is tasked with taking down Victor LaGraine, a ruthless crime lord who has evaded justice for years. As Jameson digs deeper into LaGraine's empire, he faces resistance from corrupt officials and intimidation from the mob. Despite the odds, Jameson finds an unlikely ally in a former hitman turned informant, who provides crucial information about LaGraine's operations.
view2: Agent Rachel Morse is assigned to investigate the activities of Marco Bianchi, a cunning mafia leader who has built a vast network of corrupt officials and terrified witnesses. As Morse navigates the treacherous landscape, she discovers that Bianchi's grip on the city is tighter than she initially thought. With the help of a mysterious informant, Morse uncovers evidence that could finally bring Bianchi to justice.

view1: One of seven passengers on a plane from Paris to Rome is secretly carrying $3 million in cash to bribe an influential Italian politician, but none of them know who it is. The politician's security team has identified at least four potential impostors among the group, and they must be extremely cautious until the true identity of the money carrier is revealed. As agents from various countries may be on board, the situation becomes increasingly complex.
view2: A mysterious individual boards a flight from London to Milan with $4 million in handbags, intending to pay off a powerful Italian businessman for his help in manipulating European Union decisions. However, the businessman's security team suspects that at least two of the other passengers are not who they claim to be, and they must remain vigilant until the money carrier reveals themselves. With multiple nations potentially involved, the stakes are high.

view1: In the harsh Jutland landscape of 1755, young soldier Erik Jensen arrives with a singular ambition: to till the unforgiving soil and reap the rewards of loyalty to the crown. However, his dreams are swiftly derailed by the iron-fisted landowner, Baron von Richter, who claims dominion over the heath. When Jensen befriends a fugitive serf, Hans, who has fled with his wife, Elara, von Richter unleashes a campaign of intimidation and violence to drive Jensen away. Undaunted, Jensen embarks on a perilous struggle for justice, putting not only his life but also the fragile bond he's formed with Hans' family at risk.
view2: On the windswept Jutland heath in 1755, a lone soldier named Søren Pedersen sets out to stake his claim on the land, driven by a fierce determination to prove himself worthy of the king's favor. But his quest for prosperity and prestige is swiftly complicated by the ruthless Baron De Graaf, who regards the heath as his personal domain. When Pedersen takes in a pair of escaped serfs, Marianne and her husband, Jørgen, De Graaf resorts to underhanded tactics to discredit Pedersen and reclaim the land for himself. As tensions escalate, Pedersen finds himself torn between his loyalty to the crown and his growing sense of responsibility towards the family that has come to rely on him.

view1: Thomas, a struggling artist in a small town, unexpectedly inherits a large sum of money from a distant aunt. His greedy landlord, Mr. Jenkins, refuses to release him from his long-term lease in the hope that Thomas will buy him off with a large payment. But Thomas refuses, and continues to work on his art even though he is now very wealthy. Before long he falls deeply in love with Mr. Jenkins' daughter, Sophia.
view2: Lucas, a young musician working at a local pub, inherits a substantial sum of money from a distant uncle. His cunning manager, Marcus, refuses to let Lucas out of his contract, hoping that the newly wealthy musician will pay him off handsomely. But Lucas stands firm and continues to perform at the pub, eventually capturing the heart of Marcus' daughter, Emma.

view1: In the serene landscape of Prussia, 1750, King Frederick II returns to Sanssouci, weary from the Silesian Wars. However, his tranquility is disrupted by the incessant din of Casper's mill, once a marvel of engineering and expense. The king issues an edict to silence the mill, but Casper refuses to comply, citing the equality before the law that Frederick himself had established. As the dispute escalates, both parties seek an out-of-court resolution. In a clever move, the king proposes a compromise: he offers to promote the marriage of two couples, including his soldiers, Lieutenant von Bärenfels and Corporal Jobst, and uses this opportunity to further his own romantic interests with the dancer Barberina.
view2: In the summer of 1750, Frederick II, King of Prussia, settles back into Sanssouci after the Silesian Wars. But his peace is shattered by the cacophony of Casper's mill, a behemoth of engineering that once boasted an extravagant price tag. The king decrees that the mill must be silenced, but Casper stands firm, invoking the principle of equality before the law that Frederick himself had enshrined in Prussian law. As tensions rise, both parties opt for a mediated solution. In a diplomatic maneuver, the king proposes to officiate at the weddings of two couples, including his loyal soldiers, Lieutenant von Bärenfels and Corporal Jobst, thereby resolving the dispute while furthering his own personal interests.

view1: Decorated World War II veteran Jack Harris returns to New York City after sustaining a head wound in combat, but his memories of life before enlistment are lost due to a rare form of amnesia. As he tries to rebuild his identity, he's mistaken for Jack 'The Ace' Anderson, a notorious bank robber who escaped from prison years ago. The police and former associates of Anderson are hot on his trail, seeking revenge for past betrayals.
view2: After being injured in combat, war hero James Mitchell is sent to a rehabilitation center in Chicago, where he's diagnosed with a permanent case of retrograde amnesia. With no memory of his life before the war, he sets out to rediscover himself, but instead, he's mistaken for Jimmy 'The Bull' Ross, a ruthless gang leader who was thought to be dead. As Mitchell navigates this new identity, he must avoid the vengeful associates of Ross and confront the dark secrets of his past.

view1: After a traumatic accident, Emily Wilson finds herself in a rehabilitation center with no recollection of her life or how she got there. Her physical therapist, Rachel Patel, helps Emily regain some memories, but those related to her job at a prestigious law firm remain elusive. As Emily tries to piece together her past, she starts experiencing terrifying nightmares and hallucinations linked to a gruesome crime scene from years ago. The perpetrators of the crime appear in the rehabilitation center, claiming not to know Emily despite their identical appearance. They begin taunting her, leaving Emily wondering if they're genuine individuals or mere manifestations of her fractured mind.
view2: Lena Grant awakens in a mental institution with no memory of her identity or how she ended up there. Her psychiatrist, Dr. Lee, assists Lena in recovering fragments of her past, including a traumatic event from her teenage years that left a lasting impact on her life. However, memories associated with her current job at a tech startup remain inaccessible to Lena. As she struggles to regain her recollection, Lena begins experiencing disturbing visions and dreams connected to the traumatic event. The individuals responsible for the incident appear in the institution, asserting they don't recognize Lena despite their identical appearance spanning over a decade. They start tormenting Lena, forcing her to question whether these encounters are real or merely products of her damaged psyche.

view1: Dr. Rachel Kim's unique condition made her an asset to the wrong people. Her brain's inability to process visual information, despite her eyes being perfect, was a secret she kept hidden from the world. When her estranged father's old business partner came looking for her, it became clear that he had ulterior motives. He planned to use Rachel's condition to extract sensitive information about her father's company, but Rachel had other plans.
view2: After being kidnapped by a group of ruthless individuals, Emma Taylor discovered she was the key to unlocking a long-lost secret. Her rare visual agnosia made her brain unable to process visual stimuli, and her captors saw this as an opportunity to extract valuable information from her. But Emma had a few tricks up her sleeve, and she was determined to outsmart them at every turn.

view1: During World War II, Anna and her husband, Michael, were torn apart by the chaos of war. After eight years in Soviet captivity, Anna returned home to find that Michael had moved on with his life, starting a new family with another woman. Heartbroken, Anna struggled to come to terms with this betrayal, but ultimately found the strength to forgive and rebuild their relationship.
view2: In the aftermath of World War II, Emma's husband, James, was left shattered when she returned home after eight years in captivity, bearing a child conceived during her time in prison. Initially consumed by anger and hurt, James eventually found it within himself to reconcile with Emma, acknowledging that the war had taken its toll on them both.

view1: For five years, Emily had been trapped in an affair with James, who seemed stuck in his mundane life. She initially hoped he would leave his wife and start a new life together. However, as time passed, she grew increasingly disillusioned with the lack of progress in their relationship and her own life. One day, she met a charming widower who shared her love for adventure and travel, and they began a whirlwind romance. Emily's family, who had been worried about her unhappiness, were overjoyed to see her happy again. With her rival out of the way, James's wife tentatively reached out to him, sparking rumors of a possible reconciliation.
view2: Sarah had been secretly seeing Alex for four years, hoping he would finally leave his wife and start anew with her. But as their affair dragged on, she became disheartened by his inability to take control of his life and their relationship. One day, while attending a friend's wedding, Sarah met a successful businessman who shared her passion for exploring new cultures. They hit it off immediately, and before long, they were engaged. Sarah's family, who had been supporting her through her unhappiness, were thrilled to see her happy again. With Alex's wife finally aware of his infidelity, she began to make amends with him, leaving the door open for a possible reconciliation.

view1: Ava Moreno (Claire Trevor) thought she'd lost her husband, Jack Harris (Dennis Morgan), forever when he went missing at sea. But six months later, he turned up, battered and bruised, after being stranded on a deserted island. The reunion was joyful, but complicated by Ava's new marriage to Jack's best friend, Alex Reynolds (Richard Conte). Now she must choose between her love for Alex and her loyalty to the man who'd been presumed dead.
view2: After her husband, Eric Taylor (James Stewart), is declared legally deceased following a shipwreck, his widow, Sarah Lee (Barbara Stanwyck), finds comfort in the company of his business partner, Tom Bradley (Cary Grant). They marry six months later, but the tranquility is shattered when Eric reappears, having survived on a remote island. Now Sarah must decide between her current husband and the man she thought was lost forever.

view1: Giovanni, a poor farmer, is accused of arson and theft. He flees to the mountains, leaving behind his family's livelihood. In desperation, he breaks into a wealthy landowner's barn and steals all their cattle, threatening them with violence. Giovanni has become a notorious outlaw.
view2: Domenico, a struggling shepherd, is wrongly accused of poaching and assault. He escapes to the rugged terrain of Sardinia, where his flock perishes due to lack of resources. One night, under duress from creditors and facing imminent trial, he raids another herdsman's enclosures at gunpoint, making off with all their livestock. Domenico has turned to a life of banditry.

view1: The rural town of Nokwon has been plagued by a string of mysterious disappearances. The local authorities are stumped, and tensions are running high as the annual Harvest Festival approaches, which is expected to bring in a significant influx of tourists and revenue. Han Gi-tae (Kim Sung-oh), whose sister was one of the missing persons, teams up with Detective Seo (Lee Jae-woo) and his partner, Officer Kim (Park Ji-hwan), who has a personal stake in solving the case. They are joined by Dr. Yoon (Jeon Moo-song), an expert in wildlife behavior, and a seasoned hunter named Park (Kim Tae-hwan). Together, they embark on a perilous journey into the mountains to track down the culprit behind the disappearances.
view2: In the sleepy town of Sambong, a series of gruesome murders has left the residents on edge. The local police are struggling to find leads, and the upcoming Mountain Mushroom Festival is looming large, threatening to bring in crowds of unsuspecting tourists. Jang Dae-hyun (Kwon Yul), whose cousin was one of the victims, joins forces with Detective Min (Kim Sung-kyun) and his new partner, Officer Cha (Park So-yi), who has a troubled past that may hold the key to solving the case. They are aided by Dr. Kim (Jung Hye-sun), an expert in forensic biology, and a grizzled outdoorsman named Oh (Kim Sung-oh). As they delve deeper into the woods, they begin to unravel the dark secrets behind the murders.

view1: A young man named Ethan, plagued by therianthropy, is institutionalized after injuring his sister in a fit of feral rage. Within the asylum's walls, he forms an unlikely alliance with a group of patients who share his affliction, including Marcus, who believes himself to be a panther. As they navigate the harsh realities of their confinement, Ethan becomes increasingly disillusioned with the brutal methods employed by Dr. Lee, the facility's director. One night, under the guise of a full moon, Ethan and his companions stage a daring escape, but not before Cecilia, a mysterious patient known as 'Raven', shares a forbidden kiss with him in the shadows.
view2: Lena, a woman consumed by lycanthropy, is admitted to a psychiatric hospital after attacking her mother. Among the other patients, she finds solace in the company of a man named Kai, who believes himself to be a bear. However, their bond is put to the test when they witness the sadistic treatment meted out by Dr. Kim, the hospital's director. As Lena becomes more entrenched in her delusions, she begins to question the true nature of her confinement. One fateful night, under the light of a full moon, Lena and Kai hatch a plan to escape, but not before sharing a passionate moment with each other in the darkness.

view1: In the decadent city of Pompeii, under the tyrannical rule of Emperor Caligula, two young men, Felix and Lucius, engaged in a tumultuous relationship with a beautiful youth named Aulus. Their constant bickering over Aulus's affections led them to seek refuge in the opulent villa of the wealthy merchant, Agathus. However, their troubles only intensified as they became embroiled in a series of misadventures with Agathus's eccentric household. Meanwhile, Felix began to cultivate a friendship with the poet, Theocritus, who introduced him to a world of art and literature. As Lucius succumbed to illness, Felix found himself alone with Aulus, but their happiness was short-lived due to a curse placed upon them by the goddess Aphrodite, which rendered Felix impotent. The trio then inherited a vast fortune from Agathus's will and moved to a new city, where they encountered a mysterious soothsayer who claimed to possess the power to lift the curse.
view2: In ancient Rome, during the reign of Emperor Claudius, two young men, Gaius and Marcus, found themselves entangled in a passionate love triangle with a handsome youth named Quintus. Their squabbles over Quintus's affections led them to seek solace in the lavish mansion of the wealthy patrician, Tullus. However, their stay was marked by chaos as they became embroiled in a series of absurd misadventures with Tullus's eccentric family. Gaius began to form a bond with the poet, Callimachus, who introduced him to the world of poetry and philosophy. As Marcus fell ill, Gaius found himself alone with Quintus, but their happiness was fleeting due to a curse cast upon them by the god Pan, which rendered Gaius infertile. The trio then inherited a vast estate from Tullus's will and moved to a new city, where they encountered a mysterious fortune teller who claimed to possess the power to break the curse.

view1: In 18th century France, the enigmatic writer, Comte de Sade, languishes in prison, pouring his thoughts and desires into his writings. His trusty confidant, a wisecracking, anthropomorphic penis named Félix, often interrupts his musings with outlandish stories that become the basis for his novels. Meanwhile, outside the Bastille walls, a group of revolutionaries, led by the fearless horsewoman, Colette de la Croix, plot to overthrow the corrupt King Louis XVI. As the Comte's writing gains notoriety, Félix becomes smitten with Colette and defects to her cause, leaving the Comte to his thoughts.
view2: In the dungeons of pre-revolutionary France, the infamous writer, Marquis de Sade, finds solace in his writing and conversations with his disembodied penis, René. However, their discussions are frequently interrupted by René's outlandish tales, which often become the basis for the Marquis' literary masterpieces. As the revolution gains momentum, a group of rebels, led by the cunning mare, Aurélia de la Fleur, hatch a plan to free the imprisoned aristocrats and bring down the monarchy.
